verdict.rationale: INPI documents a representative rail: holders or applicants of industrial property rights can update their mandatários' (representatives') details free of charge, which implies a sanctioned mechanism for a third party to act on the company's behalf. The evidence is a single thin mention and does not describe how a representative is appointed or who qualifies. Missing for 10: documentation of who may act as an authorized representative (e.g. official IP agents), the appointment or power-of-attorney procedure, the scope of what a representative can do, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
